plugin.name: Test Lab
plugin.description: Exercises every platform capability, one tab per permission, plus a self-test.
lab.subtitle: Every capability of the plugin platform, in one place.
kit.denied: Permission not granted. Nothing was done.
error.os_permission_denied: macOS denied access. Allow Medeo in System Settings › Privacy & Security.
error.capability_unavailable: Not available on this computer or in this build.
error.no_audio_frames: No sound arrived. Is anything playing?
error.shortcut_conflict: That shortcut is already in use.
error.operation_quota: Too many operations in flight; try again shortly.
error.helper_unavailable: The system helper is not available.
error.location_failed: Could not get a location fix.
error.calendar_read_only: The default calendar is read only.
error.origin_not_allowed: That address is not in this plugin's allowed list.
media.mic_idle: Press the red button and speak
media.camera_idle: The camera picture appears while recording
media.pick: Pick a recording to play it
media.os_first: macOS asks for access the first time you record.
media.os_denied: macOS has not allowed this. Open System Settings › Privacy & Security and allow Medeo, then try again.
microphone.hint: Records the default microphone. Levels update live; every take keeps a waveform you can scrub.
system_audio.hint: Records what this Mac is playing (not the microphone). Medeo's own sounds are left out.
camera.hint: Records the default camera without sound. A live picture shows while recording.
storage.intro: Keeps small values for this plugin only.
file_full_access.intro: Moves files you pick straight to the Trash.
agent_api.intro: Chats with the configured AI model.
clipboard_read.intro: Reads text from the clipboard when you ask.
camera.intro: Records the camera with a live picture.
microphone.intro: Records your voice with a live waveform.
system_audio.intro: Records what this Mac is playing.
plugin_commands.intro: Lists your other plugins’ commands and runs one.
tray.intro: Adds a menu to the menu bar.
accessibility.intro: Reads other apps' windows and selected text.
browser_view.intro: Shows a web page in an isolated window.
power.intro: Keeps the Mac or display awake.
device_access.intro: Talks to serial, HID and Bluetooth devices.
notify.compose_hint: Pick a template or write your own.
notify.title: Title
notify.preview_hint: Roughly how it appears in the top-right corner.
notify.history_hint: Withdraw one to remove it from Notification Center.
notify.preset.reminder_body: You have been editing for 50 minutes.
notify.preset.alert_body: Low disk space. Free up 2 GB to continue.
tray.editor_hint: Up to 12 items. Changes show on the right right away; Apply puts them in the menu bar.
tray.title: Menu bar title
tray.preview_hint: Click the title in the real menu bar to try it.
tray.clicks_hint: Each click in the real menu arrives here.
shortcuts.new_hint: Click the box, then press a key combination. Letters, digits, arrows, Space and F-keys work.
shortcuts.open_ui: Open this window instead of sending an event
shortcuts.registered_hint: Works while Medeo is running, even when another app is in front.
shortcuts.presses_hint: Switch to another app and press it.
windows.new_hint: The plugin opens another of its own pages in a separate window.
windows.title: Test Lab window {n}
windows.list_hint: Bring one to the front or close it.
power.title: Stay awake
power.hint: Turned off automatically when you leave this tab.
power.prevent-app-suspension.hint: The Mac may dim the screen but keeps working (exports, uploads).
power.prevent-display-sleep.hint: The screen stays on, like during a presentation.
power.note: Check it in Activity Monitor › Energy › Preventing Sleep.
background.new_hint: Runs even when this window is closed, as long as Medeo is running.
background.name: Task name
background.runs_hint: Each run arrives here with its payload.
clipboard.write_hint: Puts the text on the clipboard; paste it anywhere with ⌘V.
clipboard.read_hint: Copy some text in any app, then read it here. Nothing is read until you click.
external.title: Open a link
browser.title: Isolated browser window
browser.hint: A separate window with no access to Medeo or this plugin. Start the server on the Local server tab first.
windows.secondary: A second window opened by the plugin. Close it any time.
storage.editor_hint: Values are JSON. Only this plugin can read them.
system.title: This computer
system.layout_hint: As arranged in System Settings › Displays.
process.title: Run a command
process.hint: This plugin may only run the program below; each line is one argument.
process.args_hint: \n inside a line becomes a line break.
approvals.compose_hint: Medeo shows the dialog and remembers “always” answers as rules.
approvals.title: Title
approvals.rule_hint: A prefix ending in *, used for “always”.
approvals.rules_hint: Forget one to be asked again.
approvals.sample_detail: The plugin wants to check the repository status.
approvals.sample_text: Replace the project title with “Summer trip”.
print.hint: Opens the system print dialog; nothing prints silently.
print.sample:
Medeo Test Lab

Printed from a plugin.
The text is escaped and shown on a plain page.
location.title: Where am I
location.hint: Accuracy is about 100 m; it is never shared.
contacts.title: Search contacts
contacts.hint: Matches by name; up to 50 results.
contacts.warning: This really adds the contact to Contacts.
calendar.week_hint: From every calendar on this Mac.
calendar.warning: This really adds the event to your default calendar.
devices.title: Connect a device
devices.hint: macOS shows its own picker; the plugin only sees the device you choose.
ax.windows_hint: Needs Accessibility in System Settings › Privacy & Security.
ax.selection_hint: Select text in that window first; password fields are refused.
creation.title: Medeo creation space
creation.hint: Opens the main Medeo window where projects are edited.
full.title: Folders with full access
full.hint: Pick a folder; files in it can be moved to the Trash without another prompt.
full.log_hint: Restore from the Trash in Finder.
network.title: Send a request
network.hint: Only allowed addresses can be called. Start the Local server tab to answer on 8765.
network.origins_hint: Declared ones come with the plugin; more can be asked for.
window_management.intro: Reads the window you are in and moves or resizes it.
wm.screens_hint: Frames in global points; the first is the main display.
wm.window_hint: Press, then switch to another app within 3 seconds: its window is read, nudged right and put back.
wm.no_window: No window: the frontmost app was Medeo or had no window
